decision.kinematics: approximately_equal; rounded joint origins, maximum direct FK position discrepancy 0.114119 mm
decision.reason: CordViP palm_lower visual geometry is scaled by 0.99 along mesh Y. It is not explained by naming, mesh format, material, or a rigid origin transform.
decision.interpretation: Modified geometry of the same v1 Full Right basis, not a different handedness, robot family, or increased DoF.

dynamics_summary.note: Joint/mesh-origin rounding causes small world-frame placement differences; it does not constitute a change to the declared local inertial parameters.

analysis_protocol.mapping: Match four root branches by origin translation/rotation and visual mesh role; walk each unique four-revolute-joint chain. Names are checked only after structural correspondence.
analysis_protocol.mesh: Parse binary STL triangle soup and OBJ vertices/faces; triangulate OBJ polygons if needed. Compare AABB, area, bidirectional nearest vertices and triangle vertex-set topology with a 2 um analysis-only weld.
analysis_protocol.palm_diagnostic: Test Y scale 0.99 in memory; fit an affine matrix by least squares and a proper rigid transform by SVD; compare corresponding landmark distances invariant to rigid transforms.
analysis_protocol.sampling: 258 joint vectors: zero, midpoint of limits, 256 deterministic samples within joint limits (seed 20261028), same mapped joint angles in both hands.
analysis_protocol.usd: Read existing Sdf layers only. No rendering, exports, conversion, stage regeneration or physics stepping.
